sections.text: Introduction

This document outlines the equipment inspection I1 for unit 5, which must be performed 
every six months as indicated by M6 in the title block.

The 
first draft is initiated by eng. Emad Mohamed El-Tohamy, tested by eng. Sawsan 
Elsaid Ali, reviewed 
& accepted by eng. 
Hanaa Nasr Abd El-Gawad general manager, approved by eng Aly Anor El-Faumy, 
and certified by eng. Mona Ahmed Al Sherqawy: WDEPC consultant engineer "A" and 
MPIS Coordinator.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued

The qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable ID safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety helmet, safety shoes and following consignment be done

sections.text: Work to be Carried Out

Boiler Circulating Pump Body 
Temperature

Check the TSHH 101A 
"temperature switch very high", from thermocouple TE 101A, range: 0 to 100 
C, high threshold 60C MZ value 0.60, LO 
(14) = 1(trip + start forbidden)

Check the TSH 101 B "temperature switch high", from 
thermocouple TE 101B, Range: 0 to 100C, high treshold 55C, MZ value 0.55, LO 
(22) = 1(alarm)

Check the TDSH 102 "differential temp switch (pump 
suction & pump body", from thermocouple TE 102 A & TE 102C, range: 0 to 400 
C, 
High threshold 56 C, MZ value 0.56, LO 17 = (1)(start forbidden), values in 
micro Z cub by using micro Z consol

Check the FLAPDSLL 001 ""pressure differential 
switch very low", from PDL 001, range :0 to 3 bar MZ value 0.58 bar, LO (33) = 
0(trip)

Check FLAPDSL 001, from PDT 001, range: 0 to 3 bar, 
MZ value 1.12 bar trip, LO (12) = 1(alarm)

Check PDT 001 "pressure differential transmitter 
(upper drum, lower drum", differential pressure between suction manifold and 
lower drum

Ensure that the two hand valves (HVC 001, HVC002) open to 
obtain pressure equal to (1.9 bar 1.8 bar) at start up.
